faqPreview.a: If you are unsure—Snapshot. If you need one domain—Starter. For 2-3 domains—Pro. For full cross-domain confidence—Complete.

faqPreview.q: How is Snapshot different from Starter/Pro/Complete?
faqPreview.a: Snapshot is a quick first check of how automated systems can access and understand your public site: what they can see, what they miss, and where clarity breaks. If the basic pass is too limited, deeper crawl checks are used when needed. Starter/Pro/Complete are broader audit packages with explicit scope and deeper domain analysis.
Yes. The report and roadmap are written so your team or another vendor can run with them.
